_comment: Minimal fixture for the SAME70Q20B USB-CDC boot/connect smoke test. No analog_in / i2c / step_trigger entries - the test just verifies that the firmware boots through SystemInit, the synthetic SET_CONFIGURATION SETUP packet from same70_usbhs.cs drives klipper's USB CDC stack to bulk-active state, and klippy completes its identify + clocksync handshake over the BULK_IN/BULK_OUT pipe Renode exposes as a pty via UARTBase.
